## Propagation (common)

| Value | Plain meaning |
|-------|----------------|
| `REQUIRED` (default) | Join existing tx or create one |
| `REQUIRES_NEW` | Suspend current; new tx |
| `NOT_SUPPORTED` | Run without tx |

## Isolation

Controls dirty reads / phantom reads tradeoffs. Higher isolation can mean more locking.

## Practice

Nest service calls with `REQUIRED` vs `REQUIRES_NEW` and log commits (or use DB rows to observe).
